register.labelZh: SHUT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: shut down 可以描述公司、服務或系統停止運作;shut off 則可以描述停止水、煤氣、電力或機器。；shut in 描述把某人或某物留在裏面;shut out 則描述阻止人、光線、聲音或其他東西進入。；你可以用 shut yourself away 表示把自己關起來獨處;用 shut yourself off 表示拒絕與人交流;用shut yourself out 表示意外把自己反鎖在外。；shut something up 可以描述離開店舖、房屋或度假屋前,把門窗關好鎖好。
register.summaryEn: Shut down can describe a business, service or system stopping. Shut off can describe stopping water, gas, electricity or a machine. Shut in describes keeping someone or something inside. Shut out describes preventing someone, light, sound or another thing from entering. You can use shut yourself away for physical privacy, shut yourself off for emotional distance and shut yourself out for an accidental lockout. Shut something up can describe closing and securing a shop, house or holiday home before leaving it empty.

fixedVariable.fixedZh: 閱讀整句,選出意思相同的 SHUT 片語動詞。
fixedVariable.fixedEn: Read the whole sentence and choose the SHUT expression that gives the same meaning.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；留意以下三個不同意思:● shut yourself away:把自己關在某處獨處;● shut yourself off:不再與其他人溝通或來往;● shut yourself out:意外把自己反鎖在外。；shut somebody up 表示令某人停止說話。這是較口語的表達,有時可能顯得不禮貌。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Pay attention to these three different ideas: ● shut yourself away: stay alone in a place; ● shut yourself off: stop communicating with other people; ● shut yourself out: accidentally leave yourself outside a locked place. Shut somebody up means to make somebody stop talking. It is informal and may sound impolite.
